privileged_info_for_vlm: The source file is located at ~/Documents/RIPA_Lysis_SOP.txt. The protocol name must be 'RIPA Lysis Protocol'. The 6 specific steps to be digitized are: 1. Wash cells twice with cold PBS. 2. Add RIPA buffer (1 mL per 10cm dish). 3. Scrape cells and transfer to microcentrifuge tube. 4. Incubate on ice for 30 min. 5. Centrifuge at 14,000xg for 15 min at 4°C. 6. Transfer supernatant to new tube.
